definitions.full: H710. argevan אַרְגְּוָן noun [masculine] purple (of Aramaic form, compare Hebrew below; perhaps text error) = purple thread 2Chr 2:6 (+ וּתְכֵלֶת כַּרְמִיל ), compare 2:13 ; 3:14 below אַרְגָּמָן . [ אַרְגְּוָן ] noun masculine purple, red-purple (Biblical Hebrew id. , אַרְגָּמָן ); — emphatic אַרְגְּוָנָא Dan 5:7 , 17 , 29 .
